svg.text: UBS Adoboli case · P&L and hidden exposure
Japanese candlesticks show monthly P&L movement; risk exposure is the number in parentheses below each month.
Bank risk limit = 100% · exposure values above it highlighted
Candle body = monthly open-to-close P&L · wick = monthly high/low range · numbers in parentheses = risk exposure (% internal limit)

svg.text: Key Lesson: Trading losses occur every day. The operational risk came from hidden positions and failed controls that
allowed risk exposure to grow unchecked.
Illustrative classroom data only — not historical UBS desk data or a precise reconstruction of Adoboli’s positions.
